introduction: North Dakota LIHEAP accepts applications year-round. Apply through the Self-Service Portal or request a paper application from the Customer Support Center.
description: North Dakota LIHEAP accepts applications year-round. Apply through the Self-Service Portal or request a paper application from the Customer Support Center.

sections.who: The state reviews household income, heating arrangements and expenses under current program rules. Explain a fuel shortage or threatened loss of heat when requesting help.
sections.get: Assistance can address part of heating costs and qualifying energy emergencies. Separate arrangements cover cooling equipment and certain heating-system services.
sections.docs:
• Recent and expected income records.
  • Heating bills or a lease showing heating arrangements.
  • Requested expense evidence and emergency notices.
sections.apply:
1. Submit the application

    Use the LIHEAP application routes.

  2. Describe an urgent problem

    Contact the Customer Support Center about a heating emergency rather than relying on an unread online submission.

  3. Follow the decision

    Keep approval information and ask how the approved service will be arranged.
sections.after: For cooling-device help, current LIHEAP recipients should ask Community Action about the approval-letter route. People without an open LIHEAP case should apply first.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using LIHEAP eligibility, intake and cooling routes. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state now describes LIHEAP as year-round.
Does assistance cover the full heating bill?
The program describes partial heating assistance; the decision controls the amount and service.
Who can help with the application?
The state lists Community Options at 800-823-2417 for application help.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
